standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Rules that keep the order at JLCPCB's base price: 0.3 mm via holes avoid the small-via surcharge.

trackWidth.anchor: Min. track width and spacing (1 oz)

clearance.anchor: Min. track width and spacing (1 oz)

viaDrill.quote: ③ 0.1mm or 0.15mm hole size with any size via diameter, and 0.2mm or 0.25mm hole size with via diameter less than 0.45mm, will cost more. Please select corresponding via size option when placing order.
viaDrill.note: 0.3 mm is the smallest via hole with no surcharge at any via diameter.

viaDiameter.quote: ① Via diameter should be 0.1mm(0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size.

viaAnnular.quote: ① Via diameter should be 0.1mm(0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size.
viaAnnular.note: Half of the 0.1 mm diameter margin.

holeMin.quote: ③ 0.1mm or 0.15mm hole size with any size via diameter, and 0.2mm or 0.25mm hole size with via diameter less than 0.45mm, will cost more. Please select corresponding via size option when placing order.
holeMin.note: KiCad applies one smallest-hole rule to vias and pads, so it follows the via hole.

pthAnnular.quote: 1 oz: Recommended 0.25 mm or above; absolute minimum 0.18 mm

copperEdge.quote: ① Copper clearance from routed board edges: ≧0.2 mm

silkWidth.quote: Characters width less than 0.15mm will be unidentifiable.

silkTextHeight.quote: Characters height less than 40 mil(1.0mm) will be unidentifiable.

silkClearance.quote: The Minimum Distance Between Pad and Silkscreen is 0.15mm.

maskWeb.quote: Min. pad spacing: 0.10 mm (green, red, yellow, blue, purple)
